in_sanskrit.name: हस्तिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds a weapon in her hands, symbolizing strength and power. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hasti’ meaning elephant and ‘ka’ meaning she or having.

in_hindi.name: हस्तिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who holds a weapon in her hands, symbolizing strength and power. The name is derived from the Hindi word ‘hasti’ meaning elephant and ‘kā’ meaning she or having.

in_tamil.name: ஹாஸ்டிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the feet of an elephant, symbolizing strength and power. The name is derived from the Tamil word ‘hāsti’ meaning elephant and ‘kā’ meaning she or having.

in_telugu.name: హెస్టికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The goddess who holds all the weapons, symbolizing strength and power. The name is derived from the Telugu word ‘hasti’ meaning elephant and ‘kā’ meaning she or having.

in_marathi.name: Hastika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hastika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Hastika refers to an elephant-headed deity, Ganesha. The name Hastika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hasti' meaning elephant.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Elephant faced
